verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: 100% of late trains were already late at 6 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Lorimer St: 19, at Bedford Av: 4, at 1 Av: 2, at or before 14 St-Union Sq: 1. Largest time loss on segment 6 Av -> target (median +90s vs schedule).
91% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 6 Av.
24% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 56% with an alert vs 18% without, lift 3.1x).
62% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (6 Av -> target, median +90s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 45% of delays on line(s) L (1.4x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 37% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 395s on average vs 54s otherwise (7.3x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
6% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'unknown' alert was active for the line (problem rate 56% with an alert vs 18% without, lift 3.1x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 10% of delays on line(s) L (0.5x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Review car-class reliability for L; pull chronic door/brake defects from peak assignments
recommendations.rationale: Mechanical alerts correlate with problem arrivals.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer disabled trains blocking the line.

recommendations.action: Inspect 6 Av -> target for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for L; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Stage a spare train set near Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy during 06:00-07:00, 19:00-20:00
recommendations.rationale: A ready spare turns a 20-minute gap into a 5-minute one.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the size of mechanical-caused gaps.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the L corridor near 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for L; add supplement trains or move work windows off 06:00-07:00, 19:00-20:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
